_comment: UPDATED 2026-09-29 -- samplesheet removed from this form. Per Cirro admin (Dima): the samplesheet now lives on the DATASET itself via Cirro's native "Upload Samplesheet" feature (see the Samples/Datasets docs), not as a per-run browser upload here. process-input.json now reads it straight from the dataset's own S3 prefix instead of decoding an uploaded blob. This form now carries only the pipeline params YAML, which still goes through preprocess.py's data-URI decode step (see .cirro/preprocess.py) since it is still a raw browser upload, not a native Cirro object.

config_file.title: SPATIA pipeline params (.yaml)
config_file.description: Pipeline parameters only -- thresholds, which steps run, marker panel, etc. No sample paths or metadata (those come from the dataset's own samplesheet, uploaded via Cirro's native Samples/Upload Samplesheet feature).
